answer: Epoch 101 admits an identity only after 3 bonded attesters from the willow, saffron, and oasis cohorts each lock 25 tokens for 14 days. At least 2 attestations must recur in 4 rounds spaced 24 hours apart. An attester’s bond doubles for each active identity it sponsors: 25, 50, 100, then 200 tokens. A contract verifies signatures, timestamps, cohort membership, and thresholds; duplicate or contradictory attestations slash the full bond.
